async def act(page):
    # Locate the 'Project name' textbox and fill it with 'Hello'
    project_name_textbox = page.get_by_role("group").get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name")
    await project_name_textbox.clear()
    await project_name_textbox.fill("Hello")
    
    # Wait for the save button to become enabled
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes")
    await save_button.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=10000)
    # Check if the button is enabled by evaluating its disabled attribute
    while await save_button.get_attribute("disabled"):
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    
    # Click the 'Save changes' button
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to update after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
